author: Seung Wook
problem: Read A and B (each up to 10^18). Each attack lowers an enemy's stamina A by B; print the minimum number of attacks needed to bring the stamina to 0 or below.
bug_description: When A is divisible by B it uses float division A/B, which loses precision for large values.

comments.accurate: Prints the number of attacks needed, A divided by B rounded up
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints A/B by true division when it divides evenly, otherwise the integer quotient plus one
comments.wrong_location: Division branches verified; check the input parsing of the two numbers
